detail: CRITICAL ANOMALY: APAAR 9821-4567-8910 (Aarav Vikram Sharma) detected holding concurrent active full-time enrolment at Demo Institute of Technology (B.Tech CSE - TFWS) and Apex Institute of Engineering (B.Tech IT - General). Dual scholarship risk flagged.
